citeAs: Mathew, M., Karatzas, D., & Jawahar, C. V. (2021). DocVQA: A Dataset for VQA on Document Images.
creator: Minesh Mathew, Dimosthenis Karatzas, C.V. Jawahar (CVIT, IIIT Hyderabad; Computer Vision Center, UAB)
description: A dataset for Visual Question Answering (VQA) on document images, consisting of 50,000 questions defined on 12,767 document images of varied types and content.
name: DocVQA
rai:annotationsPerItem: 2-3 (One worker creates the question-answer pair, a second worker verifies by answering the question. If they disagree, a third stage review is done by the authors.)
rai:annotatorDemographics: Remote workers and the authors themselves (for the third stage review).
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The second annotation stage aims to verify the data collected in the first stage. If none of the answers entered in the first stage match exactly with any of the answers from the second stage, the particular question is sent for review in a third stage where the reviewer either accepts the question-answer or ignores it.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: In stage 1, workers were shown a document image and asked to define at most 10 question-answer pairs on it, entering the answer verbatim from the document. In stage 2, a worker was shown an image and questions defined on it in the first stage, and was required to enter answers for the questions and assign question types. In stage 3, if answers didn't match, the question was sent for review by the authors.
rai:dataCollection: Images in the dataset are sourced from documents in UCSF Industry Documents Library. Documents were downloaded from different collections and pages were hand picked for use in the dataset, prioritizing pages with tables, forms, lists and figures over pages which only have running text.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Documents in UCSF Industry Documents Library, including typewritten, printed, handwritten and born-digital text from 5 major industries: tobacco, food, drug, fossil fuel and chemical.
rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: Documents from as early as 1900 to as recent as 2018.
rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Manual Human Curator
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The data is split randomly in an 80:10:10 ratio to train, validation and test splits.
rai:dataUseCases: Visual Question Answering (VQA) on document images
rai:machineAnnotationTools: A commercial OCR application was used to extract OCR tokens.
